name: F1-anticipation
pose: Pre-rush compressed anticipation at 0-80ms. Clearly different from horizontal terminal F3: crouch compact and gathered, both knees deeply bent underneath body, hips LOWER than shoulders, weight loaded on rear supporting hoof, front hoof near body poised to launch. Torso inclined 35 degrees forward, muzzle looking right, shoulders down and ready. Near hand holds original small knife close to hip pointing down/right, far elbow bent and tucked back. Tail curves naturally behind left, mane drapes backward with restrained anticipation. Both feet on same support plane, not a wide split lunge, not airborne, not running contact. Make a believable coiled spring pose.

Forceful short RUNNING STRIDE toward RIGHT: torso pitched forward about40 degrees (not nearly horizontal); lead knee raised in front to waist height with hoof LOWER than knee, rear leg extends back to left with rear hoof pushing off, open separated silhouette. Both elbows bent in sprint rhythm, knife close to lower ribs angled forward/down, no sword thrust. Muzzle looks right, antlers forward enough to show rush. Tail/mane/cloth flow left. Clearly a forward stride/contact, NOT Special high horizontal kick, NOT upright planted sword slash, NOT same deep horizontal terminal charge. Exactly two legs, one front flexed knee and one rear extended leg.

name: B-return-contact
pose: SECOND RUSH angled RETURN/CROSSING CONTACT at300ms: a sharply twisting banking pivot silhouette, clearly different from straight terminal F3 and first raised-knee stride. Canonical head faces RIGHT but torso twists three-quarter toward viewer: shoulders bank into turn, hips counter-rotate, lead hoof plants forward-right below shoulder with deeply bent knee, trailing leg folds up backward-left with heel near hip. Weight forward over plant foot, one readable planted support hoof and one lifted trailing hoof, not both stretched on ground. Near bent knife arm sweeps close across lower torso with original compact blade pointing right/down, far arm opens bent outward/back for balance. Strong asymmetric shoulders/hips. Tail bends in a broad C curve to left from turning inertia, white mane arcs behind. NO high kick, NO enlarged knife, NO slash light. Full figure.

name: F4-recovery
pose: Grounded RECOVERY after third rush460-650ms, easing back toward approved Idle. Torso rises to mostly upright20-degree forward lean; both knees softly bent, near/front hoof planted just ahead and rear hoof stepping underneath hips. Stance narrower than terminal F3; head upright looking right, shoulders settle. Knife near hand lowered beside thigh with tip right/down, far hand relaxes but stays visible. Tail and cloth fall behind left with restrained recoil, white mane settles. Clearly a decelerating recovery step, not F1 deep crouch, not wide contact, no new attack or kick, NO fourth hit.
